text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B after a gain, then bought it back; I should make decisions based on future risk and return, not on whether I can lock in a gain.","I tend to judge each stock against my purchase price and resist admitting mistakes; average cost is not a reason to keep holding or to sell.","Past price moves did not predict what came next, so I should avoid frequent reactive trades and keep diversification and overall portfolio risk in view."]}
